currentPublishedRates.title: Rolka Loube TRS Providers
currentPublishedRates.use: published 2026-27 VRS reimbursement amounts only; not normative authority for tier semantics

requirements.requirement: For a provider handling one million conversation minutes or less in a month, all applicable VRS conversation minutes use the small-provider compensation amount for that Fund Year.
For a provider handling more than one million conversation minutes in a month, the first 1,000,000 applicable conversation minutes use the large-provider Tier I amount.
For a provider handling more than one million conversation minutes in a month, applicable conversation minutes above 1,000,000 use the Tier II amount.
Video-Text Service receives the applicable base compensation amount plus the Fund-Year Video-Text additive for each Video-Text conversation minute.
Each succeeding Fund Year's per-minute compensation amounts through June 30, 2028 are redetermined from the prior year's amounts using the annual Inflation Adjustment Factor.

A provider-specific exogenous per-minute adjustment is added only for well-documented allowable claims approved by the Commission on or before June 30, calculated as approved claims divided by projected Fund-Year minutes.

authorityBoundary: externally established compensable minutes are an input; the rate engine does not establish compensability
published rate tables do not override the CFR one-million-minute boundary
rate calculation does not create a payable Fund claim or accounting journal
